observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a black DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' printed clearly on the pentaprism hump and 'D610' visible below it.
No lens is attached; the mirror box and lens mount are exposed in photos 0 and 1.
Photo 2 shows the top plate: mode dial, LCD info panel showing some reading, and a hot shoe that appears worn/tarnished with visible grime on the contacts.
A faded red rubber grip strip is visible on the front right side of the body in photos 0 and 1, consistent with handling wear.
No battery, charger, strap, bag, or box is shown in any photo despite being mentioned in the seller's text.
No power-on screen, shutter count, or sensor/lens-mount close-up is shown to confirm functionality.

claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition
claims.evidence: Photos show cosmetic wear (worn grip, dirty hot shoe) and no power-on or function test is visible, so 'good condition' functionally is unverified.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows a worn/tarnished hot shoe and photo 0/1 show a faded grip strip.

claims.claim: Comes with original battery and...(text cut off)
claims.evidence: No battery, charger, or accessories are visible in any of the 3 photos.
Photos 0 and 1 clearly show 'Nikon' branding and 'D610' model text on the camera body, not Canon.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or may have sensor/shutter faults not visible in static photos.
risks.proof: A video or photo of the camera powered on with a test image on the rear LCD, plus shutter count reading.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / body-only worst case

risks.risk: No lens is included, which significantly affects usable value.
risks.proof: Photo showing a lens included in the sale, or explicit confirmation it is body-only.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, no lens

risks.risk: Battery, charger, and other claimed accessories are not shown and may not be included or may be third-party.
risks.proof: A single photo showing the battery, charger, and any other included accessories together with the camera.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, accessories not included

risks.risk: Hot shoe contacts appear dirty/worn, which could indicate corrosion or heavier use than described.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of cleaned hot shoe contacts and confirmation flash sync works.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worse than 'good condition' claim

risks.risk: Mismatched brand claim in listing text raises concern about listing accuracy or possible mix-up/scam intent.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation and a fresh photo set consistent with the claimed brand/model.
risks.if_unproven: treated as a red flag, identity taken strictly from photos (Nikon D610)

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, showing a live view/test shot and shutter count.
Photo of the battery, charger, and any other accessories laid out next to the camera.
Close-up of the lens mount and sensor for dust/scratches or fungus.
Clarification on whether a lens is included, and if so, a photo of it.
response.reason: Photos clearly identify a Nikon D610 body with no lens, no proof of power-on or accessories, and a seller text claim of 'Canon' that is contradicted by the photos; price must be set at worst case (unverified function, body only) using the only comparable Nikon DSLR listings in the market.
